{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Filcher''''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Cargo ferry]] that, along with its sister ship ''[[Riirdo]]'', was ferrying stolen Imperial munitions to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] sent [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|Stormtrooper transports]] and [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] to disable the cargo ferry and arrest its crew for aiding and abetting the rebels. The ship was destroyed afterwards. The event was recorded into the [[Combat chamber]] to train future pilots such as [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
